transitions.sourceAction: Character gasps at drooping Leafy on desk.
transitions.easingDescription: overshoot-and-settle; clamp before using as a spatial interpolation
clarityRisks: Speech tail, hand fingers, plant label, lamp not becoming guide mark.
Leafy face must read as plant, not a second character head.

transitions.targetAction: Character cries and pleads beside plant near bed/window.
transitions.easingDescription: small anticipation before moving, then a settling arrival
clarityRisks: Leafy face must read as plant, not a second character head.
Bubble must point to character, not plant.

transitions.sourceAction: Character cries and pleads beside plant near bed/window.
transitions.targetAction: Character carefully adds one drop with medicine dropper.

clarityRisks: Bubble must point to character, not plant.
